issues.title: sensors: F2:T6 fails on eight high-severity dependency advisories
issues.body:
## Problem

The second self-scorecard SC-20261001T194346-001 (record/proofs/compliance/scorecards/, observed at c0681069) reads F2:T6 FAIL: `pnpm audit` reports 8 high-severity advisories against the review threshold of 5. The first scorecard read PASS. No CMP-0004 record caused it.

Upgrade, replace, or (with an Owner waiver recorded like the docs-site waivers) accept each advisory.

issues.title: tests: local coverage producer fails inside the sweep on release-lifecycle-execution.test.ts
issues.body:
## Problem

While recording SC-20261001T194346-001 (record/proofs/compliance/scorecards/, observed at c0681069), the first-pass `test_coverage_depth` read FAIL (`COVERAGE_PRODUCER_FAILED`): the local coverage producer (`tests/config/local.coverage.config.ts`) exited 1 with `release-task-policy-identity-mismatch` from `release-lifecycle-execution.test.ts`. A standalone run immediately after read PASS (91.66%). Under ADR-SCR-0008 the later reading governed, so F3:T2 is PASS, but the producer is order- or load-sensitive. ADR-SCR-0007 makes the coverage cell depend on the whole local suite passing.

## Proposed approach

Reproduce under the sweep's conditions, fix the test isolation, and keep enough producer output in the reading to name the failing test.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The producer passes repeatably inside a full sweep
- [ ] A failing producer reading names the failing test file

## Sources

- docs/dev/operations/trustworthy-observations-campaign/README.md section 7
- ADR-SCR-0007

issues.title: tests: guard the coverage producer against recursion from the test scope
issues.body:
## Problem

`packages/cli/tests/unit/sense-adapter-acceptance.test.ts` runs every local read sensor, including `test_coverage_depth`, under `authority-host-test-scope`. The scope refuses the coverage producer today, so the reading is `unknown` (`COVERAGE_PRODUCER_REFUSED`). If someone adds the governed coverage configs to that scope, the test would start the full local producer from inside a producer run and recurse.

## Proposed approach

Add a guard (e.g. an environment marker the producer sets and the sensor honours) or a test that fails when the scope admits the producer.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Adding the configs to the test scope cannot recurse; a test proves it

## Sources

issues.title: ci: the PR gate's bootstrap cache is unsafe on a hit
issues.body:
## Problem

`.github/workflows/pull-request-checks.yml` caches only `.devai/state/pr-bootstrap`; the runner's `node_modules` links into `packages/cli/node_modules`, so a cache hit skips the workspace build and the runner fails with `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND @devai-nyx/sensors/dist`. First seen on #198 (run 36654220587); the workaround is deleting the cache entry.

## Proposed approach

Cache the workspace `dist` outputs with the runner, or make the runner self-contained (ADR-CHK-0003).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A cache hit after a green run of the same PR still runs the gate successfully

issues.title: review: make the model-advisory review bridge ready for a live campaign
issues.body:
## Problem

Found in the CMP-0003 OE-05 live experiment: (1) a `claude -p --json-schema` reply ends with `stop_reason: tool_use` and `terminal_reason: completed` while `structured_output` is present, which the bridge maps to `reply_provider_error`; (2) `--tools ''` does not disable the user's MCP servers; (3) the envelope `result` is not byte-identical to `JSON.stringify(structured_output)`, so the fixture format of ADR-MDL-0001 must say which bytes it stores; (4) Codex `--output-schema`/OpenAI strict outputs may require every property in `required` while `review-verdict.schema.json` keeps some optional.

## Proposed approach

Fix the finish mapping, run the review with no MCP server, fix the stored bytes, and confirm both hosts accept the schema.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A live review on each host returns a valid verdict with no tool or MCP use
- [ ] Fixtures record the declared bytes

## Sources

- docs/dev/operations/harness-convergence-campaign/README.md backlog
- ADR-MDL-0001

issues.title: sensors: action_effect_inference throws ENOENT in an adopter without the effects policy
issues.body:
## Problem

`actionEffectInference` in `packages/cli/src/commands/sense/adapter-readers.ts` reads `law/policy/subprocess-effects.json` (or the declared `subprocessRegistry`) with an unguarded `readFileSync`, so in a clean adopter the sensor throws ENOENT and emits no reading; the packed sweep therefore cannot demand a reading from every member.

## Proposed approach

Read UNKNOWN (or a structured not-applicable, per ADR-CHK-0005's pattern) with a named code when the registry is absent.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A clean adopter fixture yields a reading for `action_effect_inference`

## Sources

- docs/dev/operations/harness-convergence-campaign/README.md backlog
